# Qisutu instance: qisutu
Alias /qisutu/static/ "/opt/qisutu/var/static/"

<Directory "/opt/qisutu/var/static/">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

ScriptAlias /qisutu/ "/opt/qisutu/bin/cgi-bin/"

<Directory "/opt/qisutu/bin/cgi-bin/">
    Options +ExecCGI -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    AddHandler cgi-script .pl
    DirectoryIndex index.pl
    CGIPassAuth On
    Require all granted
    SetEnv QISUTU_HOME /opt/qisutu
</Directory>

RedirectMatch 301 ^/qisutu$ /qisutu/
---
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 1333 Oct 15 14:12 qisutu-daemon.service

observation.command: ls -la /etc/apache2/sites-available/ /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/ 2>&1; echo '---'; cat /etc/apache2/sites-available/qisutu.conf 2>&1; echo '---'; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ 2>&1 | grep -i qisutu
